name: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Ltd
title: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Ltd - 504973 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Chola MS general insurance: combined ratio rose to 115.2% (112.2% ex-1/n) on motor OD and TP reserving, with ROE guidance softened to a medium-to-long-term 15%+ and no numeric combined-ratio guide.

triggers.label: Combined ratio 115.2% for FY26
triggers.quote: the combined ratio for the year was at 115.2% and 112.2% without the 1/n effect

triggers.label: Motor OD price realisation up 7-8%
triggers.quote: we have seen about 7% to 8% improvement in the price realization for us

triggers.label: ROE target softened to medium-to-long term

red_flags.label: Motor OD claims ratio up ~10% vs industry 5-7%
red_flags.quote: for us the delta has been about 10%

red_flags.label: Solvency down to 1.96x from 2.18x
red_flags.quote: We're bringing the solvency level down from 2.18x to 1.96x

red_flags.label: Dividend withheld; ROE 10.4%
red_flags.quote: Shareholders have been considered not to take a dividend

evasions.quote: I would not want to venture into giving any guidance on what we would do on combined
